sabre/vobject.reason: sabre/dav 4.x, which runs the CalDAV server, requires sabre/vobject 4 and sabre/xml 2; vobject 5 needs sabre/xml 3 or 4, so Composer cannot install it.
sabre/vobject.until: a sabre/dav release that allows sabre/vobject 5 (sabre-io/dav#1415); the weekly check flags new sabre/dav majors as usual
